source: curated by hand (2026-11-03, mcp-server.md §12.9) from the profile by tools/machine-profiler.py on linux, 2026-11-03 and the evidence listed Updated by hand (2026-11-06, mcp-server.md §12.15, U6 for the Pedal synths) for MIDI input, and (§12.15, the follow-ups) for VCF Reso's new default and the voices' tuning.
summary: Juno-106-style 6-voice polysynth: saw, pulse, sub and noise into a resonant 4-pole low-pass, one ADSR for filter and amp, an LFO and the BBD chorus. For pads, brass, keys, plucks and basses.
use_for: Warm six-voice analog-style pads, stabs and basses with a resonant low-pass.
quirks: MIDI notes (notes_write's default) take any of its 6 voices, a free one first, else the one released longest ago; velocity sets each note's level (velocity / 127), pitch bend moves every voice ±2 semitones, the mod wheel brings in the DCO LFO's vibrato (as DCO LFO, up to its maximum) and the sustain pedal holds released notes.
Its Note track (notes_write with input "tracks") still plays as before, for old songs: one voice per track, 6 at most, a chord spread over tracks, at full level (Pattern track = voice, README).
No glide (portamento) between notes (README, v1.0 limitations).
One envelope drives both the filter (VCF Env Amt) and, with VCA Mode at Env, the amplifier, as on the Juno-106.

Each voice is detuned a little and drifts slowly, like analog oscillators, within a cent: A4 plays at −0.8, +0.2, −0.4, +0.6, −0.1 and +0.5 cents on voices 1 to 6 (tracks 1 to 6; a lone MIDI note takes voice 6). Until the follow-ups (§12.15) voices 1, 3 and 5 played 9.6 cents flatter, and songs made then hear them in tune now.

VCF Reso defaults to 0. Where the envelope or VCF Freq takes the filter to its ceiling (0.45 × the sample rate: at the default VCF Freq 100 and VCF Env Amt 80, any note from about C2 up), VCF Reso from about 20 rings on there as a steady tone at 0.41 × the rate (18.2 kHz at 44.1 kHz, 19.8 at 48), most of the output's energy, and two voices' tones can cancel: lower VCF Env Amt or VCF Freq before raising VCF Reso. Its default was 30, which rang (a song saved then keeps its 30); none of the factory presets rings.
Mono voices into the chorus: stereo only with Chorus I, II or III on (HPF and chorus come after the voices).

parameters.name: LFO Rate
parameters.description: Speed of the triangle LFO, 0.1–30 Hz on an exponential scale.
parameters.how: Sets the triangle LFO's speed from 0.1 to 30 Hz.
parameters.sound: Slow rates drift; fast ones give vibrato or wobble.

parameters.name: LFO Delay
parameters.description: Time the LFO takes to fade in after each note starts, 0–5 s (0: at once).
parameters.how: Fades the LFO in over 0 to 5 s after each note starts.
parameters.sound: Notes start steady and the vibrato arrives afterward.

parameters.name: DCO LFO
parameters.description: LFO to oscillator pitch, up to ±1 semitone.
parameters.how: Sends the LFO to pitch, up to one semitone.
parameters.sound: Gives vibrato from subtle to wide.

parameters.name: DCO PWM
parameters.description: How far the PWM source moves the pulse width (100%: ±45 points of width).
parameters.how: Sets how far the PWM source moves the pulse width, up to 45 points either way.
parameters.sound: Gives the moving, thickening sound of pulse width modulation.

parameters.name: DCO PWM Src
parameters.description: What moves the pulse width: Manual (DCO PW alone), the LFO or the envelope.
parameters.how: Chooses what moves the pulse width: the manual knob, the LFO or the envelope.
parameters.sound: A manual width is static; the LFO gives chorus-like movement; the envelope makes it change with each note.

parameters.name: DCO PW
parameters.description: Pulse width with PWM Src at Manual, 50% (square) to 95% (thin).
parameters.how: Sets the pulse width from 50 percent (square) to 95 percent (thin) when the source is Manual.
parameters.sound: A square sounds hollow; thin pulses sound reedy and nasal.

parameters.name: DCO Range
parameters.description: 16' plays an octave down, 8' as written, 4' an octave up.
parameters.how: Chooses 16', 8' or 4' for the oscillator's register.
parameters.sound: Sounds an octave down, as written, or an octave up.

parameters.name: DCO Pulse
parameters.description: Adds the pulse wave.
parameters.how: Switches the pulse wave on or off.
parameters.sound: Adds a hollow, woody tone to the mix.

parameters.name: DCO Saw
parameters.description: Adds the sawtooth wave (on by default).
parameters.how: Switches the sawtooth wave on or off; it is on by default.
parameters.sound: Adds a bright, buzzy tone to the mix.

parameters.name: DCO Sub
parameters.description: Square wave one octave below.
parameters.how: Sets the level of a square wave one octave down, from 0 to 100 percent.
parameters.sound: Adds weight and bass.

parameters.name: DCO Noise
parameters.description: White noise into the filter.
parameters.how: Sets the level of white noise into the filter, from 0 to 100 percent.
parameters.sound: Adds breath, hiss and a rough edge.

parameters.name: HPF
parameters.description: One-pole high-pass after the voices: Off, 1 ≈ 100 Hz, 2 ≈ 200 Hz, 3 ≈ 400 Hz.
parameters.how: Chooses a one-pole high-pass after the voices: off, or about 100, 200 or 400 Hz.
parameters.sound: Higher settings thin out the bass.

parameters.name: VCF Freq
parameters.description: Low-pass cutoff before modulation, 30 Hz – 16 kHz exponential.
parameters.how: Sets the low-pass cutoff before modulation, from 30 Hz to 16 kHz.
parameters.sound: Low cutoffs sound dark and muffled; high ones open up and brighten.

parameters.name: VCF Reso
parameters.description: 4-pole ladder feedback; self-oscillates at the top.
parameters.how: Adds feedback at the cutoff, from 0 to 100 percent; the top self-oscillates.
parameters.sound: Low values are smooth; higher values whistle and squelch.

parameters.name: VCF Env Amt
parameters.description: How far the envelope opens the cutoff, up to 6 octaves.
parameters.how: Sets how far the envelope opens the cutoff, up to 6 octaves.
parameters.sound: Notes start bright and settle dark: the classic pluck or brass swell.

parameters.name: VCF Env Pol
parameters.description: + opens the filter with the envelope, − closes it.
parameters.how: Chooses whether the envelope opens (+) or closes (-) the filter.
parameters.sound: A negative envelope makes notes start dark and open later in reverse.

parameters.name: VCF LFO
parameters.description: LFO to cutoff, up to ±4 octaves.
parameters.how: Sends the LFO to the cutoff, up to 4 octaves either way.
parameters.sound: Gives a wah-like sweep.

parameters.name: VCF Key Trk
parameters.description: How much the cutoff follows the note (100%: an octave per octave, around C4).
parameters.how: Sets how much the cutoff follows the note, up to 100 percent (an octave per octave around C4).
parameters.sound: At 0 high notes are duller; at 100 the tone stays the same across the keyboard.

parameters.name: VCA Mode
parameters.description: Env: the envelope shapes the level; Gate: full level while the note is held.
parameters.how: Chooses whether the envelope shapes the level (Env) or the note simply holds at full level (Gate).
parameters.sound: Env gives plucks and swells; Gate gives an organ-like on and off.

parameters.name: VCA Level
parameters.description: Master gain after the voices.
parameters.how: Sets the output level after the voices, from 0 to 100 percent.
parameters.sound: Turns the whole synth up or down.

parameters.name: Env A
parameters.description: Envelope attack (linear rise), 1 ms – 4 s exponential.
parameters.how: Sets the envelope's attack from 1 ms to 4 s.
parameters.sound: Short attacks are percussive; long ones swell in slowly.

parameters.name: Env D
parameters.description: Envelope decay to the sustain level, 5 ms – 8 s exponential.
parameters.how: Sets the time the envelope takes to fall to the sustain level, from 5 ms to 8 s.
parameters.sound: Short decays pluck; long ones keep the note bright.

parameters.name: Env S
parameters.description: Level held while the note is down.
parameters.how: Sets the level held while the key is down, from 0 to 100 percent.
parameters.sound: Low sustain makes plucks; high sustain holds pads.

parameters.name: Env R
parameters.description: Envelope release after the note ends, 5 ms – 8 s exponential.
parameters.how: Sets how long the envelope takes to fall after the key is let go, from 5 ms to 8 s.
parameters.sound: Short releases cut off; long ones leave a tail.

parameters.name: Chorus
parameters.description: BBD chorus: I ≈ 0.5 Hz lush, II ≈ 0.9 Hz denser, III ≈ 9.9 Hz fast warble; makes the output stereo.
parameters.how: Chooses the chorus: off, I (slow and lush), II (denser) or III (fast warble).
parameters.sound: Widens the sound into stereo and adds shimmer.
